report:
In the medial compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The lateral compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The patellofemoral joint, the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact  
 In the intercondylar notch, the anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments are intact There is no tibial translation. 
 The medial collateral ligament complexes are intact The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact The popliteofibular ligament is intact The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 No knee effusion is present. The surrounding musculature is normal. There is no fracture or bone contusion.   Normal MR examination of the right knee.  Specifically, there is no evidence of meniscal, ligamentous, or articular cartilage abnormality.

Findings:  There is a minor knee effusion. Normal medial and lateral menisci. No evidence of tears.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  The tibiofemoral articular cartilage is well preserved. There is mild - moderate thinning of the lateral patellar facet articular cartilage with minor underlying bony change. Normal trochlear articular cartilage.  
Conclusion: No meniscal tear. Mild lateral patellar chondral degeneration.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Meniscopatía interna.
Hallazgos:
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
El menisco lateral es de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Rotura compleja del cuerpo y cuerno posterior del menisco medial con segmento que se insinúa al receso
menisco tibial a nivel del cuerpo con edema las partes blandas adyacentes. También se observa edema
óseo periférico del platillo tibial medial con imagen de pequeña fractura subcortical.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y total de la región central y de carga del cóndilo femoral medial con
cambios óseos secundarios.
Resto de los cartílagos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones. Condropatía superficial de la
faceta lateral de la rótula.
Leve derrame articular. No hay quistes poplíteos patológicos.
Leve aumento de señal del tercio proximal del tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura. Cambios entesopáticos
cuadricipitales distales.
Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.
No hay alteraciones de señal de la grasa de Hoffa.
Impresión:
Rotura compleja del menisco medial con segmento que se insinúa al receso menisco tibial a nivel del cuerpo
con edema de las partes blandas.
Edema óseo periférico del platillo tibial con imagen sugerente pequeña fractura subcortical, probablemente
de manera reactiva.
Condropatía lesiones grado 3 y 4 de la región central y de carga del cóndilo femoral medial.
Condropatía superficial de la faceta lateral de la rótula.
Leve derrame articular.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal. Cambios entesopáticos cuadricipitales distales.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Condropatía patelofemoral
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Meniscos de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios categóricos de rotura.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial de la región central de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral
medial. El resto de los cartílagos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones.
Condropatía rotuliana superficial difusa.
No hay significativo derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.
Aumento de señal del tercio proximal del tendón rotuliano y de la inserción distal del tendón
cuadricipital, sin signos de rotura.
Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.
No hay alteraciones de señal de la grasa de Hoffa.
Impresión:
Condropatía con lesiones grado 2 de la región central de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral
medial.
Condropatía rotuliana superficial difusa.
Discreta tendinosis rotuliana proximal y cuadricipital distal

Ön çapraz bağ sinyali artmıştır(miksoid dejenerasyon). Medial kollateral ligaman çevresinde hafif ödem izlendi.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Patella lateral faset düzeyinde kıkırdakta bütünlük kaybı, incelme ve komşu kemik yapıda subkondral ve medullada kemik iliği ödemi mevcuttur (tip 4 kondromalazi ).Eklemde sıvı artışı saptanmamıştır. Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Mildly thickened with moderate surrounding edema consistent with grade 1 sprain.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.

No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
Acute grade 1 MCL sprain.

Medial menisküste grade III dejenerasyon ve posterior hornunda gövdeye doğru ulaşan kompleks yırtık izlenmiştir. Medial menisküs mediale doğru ekstrüde görünümdedir.Arka çapraz bağ ,Lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir. Medial kollateral ligaman çevresinde belirgin sıvı artışı izlenmiştir ( grade I sprain).Ön çapraz bağ sinyali diffüz hafif artmıştır. Patellar tendon normal. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinakulumlar normaldir. Patella süperior lateral kesimi düzeyinde bipartial patella ile uyumlu olabilecek görünüm izlendi. Ayrıca patellar kıkırdak medial fasette kıkırdakta fokal incelme izlenmiştir (tip II kondromalazi).Arka çapraz bağ posterior komşuluğunda 32x15 mm boyutlarında lobüle konturlu kist izlenmiştir (ganglion kisti).Femur interkondiler düzeyde anteriorda subkondral milimetrik kistler izlenmiştir. Suprapatellar burada ve diz eklemi içerisinde hafif sıvı artışı izlenmiştir.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain for one year with worsening in the last 3 months.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture. Normal background marrow signal. No focal osseous lesion.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Mild myxoid degeneration without tear.
Medial compartment cartilage: Intact.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Discoid meniscus with complex tearing involving the anterior horn, body and posterior horn with dominant horizontal component. Hypoplastic posterior root.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Articular cartilage irregularity at the weightbearing aspect of the joint without focal chondral defect.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Full-thickness chondral loss at the inferior aspect of the trochlea with associated subchondral signal changes. Low-grade articular cartilage loss at the patellar median ridge.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): No tear.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): No tear.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Periligamentous edema, likely related to adjacent meniscal pathology.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Extensor Apparatus: Normal quadriceps tendon. Normal patellar tendon.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. Patella alta. Tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance is 10 mm, normal.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No disproportionate muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1.	Discoid lateral meniscus with extensive complex tearing at the anterior horn, body and posterior horn.
2.	Moderate patellofemoral and mild lateral tibiofemoral compartment chondrosis.
3.	Small knee joint effusion.
